newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IFS shareholder says not considering offer.
newsitem.headline: IFS shareholder says not considering offer.

text.p: A substantial shareholder of financial services group International Factors Singapore Ltd (IFS) said on Friday it will not consider any offers for its stake in the company at the present time.
ECICS Holdings Ltd, which holds 39.36 million IFS shares or 38.68 percent of the company, said it had recieved offers for its stake through various merchant banks.

"Even before the directors of ECICS could give an a serious consideration to these offers, there was an unprecendented surge in the volume of IFS shares traded on the Stock Exchange of Singapore," said an ECICS statement.
ECICS therefore asked IFS to request for suspension of its shares on December 11 pending an announcement.
ECICS said it has decided "not to proceed at the present time with any of the offers received" for purchase of its block of IFS shares.
It added that the exchange has been asked to lift the voluntary suspension of the trading of IFS shares.
